items.title: Eddie B. Edwards Interview, 1959-07-01
items.q: We opened at the Schiller Cafe owned by Sam Ahern, managed by Harry James, the latter style as a jazz band... We had never heard the term used before in connection with music or a band

ctx.x: Sidney Lansfield, a celebrated movie director for Adolph Zucca, and who substituted in the original Dixieland Jazz Band in 1917, when Henry Ragus was ill in New Orleans for two weeks.

Here we go. It's ready. We left New Orleans for Chicago Thursday, March 2, 1916, 8.30 a.m. I arrived in Chicago Friday, March 3, 1916, about 9.30. This train was late due to a severe snowstorm. Mom said, take you overboard. Mom don't know. We couldn't be bothered with those things besides it was warm in New Orleans. We did take our new straw hats and walk down Wabash Avenue in zero temperature with them. We opened at the Schiller Cafe owned by Sam Ahern, managed by Harry James, the latter style as a jazz band,…
